title: All-Inclusive Sandbar Safari with Dolphin Playground Encounter
includes: Assortment of Water Toys - Toss a football, grab a snorkel or enjoy any of the multiple water toys at the sandbar
Secluded Sandbar – Relax on a picturesque sandbar with stunning turquoise waters.
Lily Pad Included - Float effortlessly as you sip on your favorite beverage on one of our lily pads
Knowledgeable Guides – Learn about local wildlife and ecosystems from expert guides.
Dolphin Playground – Watch dolphins play in their natural habitat up close.
Swim, Snorkel, or Sunbathe – Enjoy water activities or simply lounge in the sun.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please arrive 60 minutes prior to departure to check in which will provide enough time to go through our check in procedures.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a journey like no other. This tour takes guests on an amazing journey from Key West to a secluded sandbar & then to the dolphin playground in the Florida Marine Sanctuary for some dolphin watching. 

With picturesque views of the Gulf of Mexico and expert guides providing insights into the history & ecology of the area, guests can relax at the sandbar while our crew fills your cups with unlimited draft beer, wine & mimosas. Next, we will venture out future into the Sanctuary to get closer than ever to our dolphin pods. The tour includes complimentary lunch (menu below) & unlimited draft beer, mimosas & wine. 

Our professional crew will make this a trip of a lifetime that you'll cherish for years to come. This trip is perfect for families, couples & solo travelers seeking a unique & unforgettable experience in the Florida Keys.
